001: Good morning, everyone, thanks for coming. Shall we start with the agenda?
Good morning, Laura. Yes, we can start whenever you're ready.
Perfect. First, we need to review the status of the project.
Agreed. I can summarize my team's progress.
Great, that way we'll get up to speed quickly.
Awesome, then I'll take the floor right now.
002: Before we continue, does anyone have any questions about the previous point?
I have a question about the budget you mentioned.
Sure, tell me and we'll look at it in detail.
Can we increase the budget line for the new software?
That decision will have to be consulted with management.
Understood, I'll note it down as a pending item for the next meeting.
003: We've talked quite a bit, could we focus on the delivery deadlines?
You're right, it's a key issue. My team proposes two more weeks.
Two weeks seems like a considerable delay for the client.
I know, but we need time to run the tests.
Okay, but I need a concrete plan to justify it.
I'll prepare a detailed document for you by tomorrow morning.
004: I'd like to hear everyone's opinion on this proposal.
In my opinion, it's feasible, although it requires more staff.
And do you think we could redistribute the current tasks?
We could try, but some colleagues are already overloaded.
Then we'll have to prioritize and leave some task for later.
That seems like a reasonable solution, we can start there.
005: We've run out of time for this point, let's move on to the next one.
Okay, but I'd like to put my disagreement on record.
Of course, your comments will be included in the minutes.
Thanks, that puts my mind at ease.
Now, let's talk about the communication campaign.
Yes, I have several ideas I want to share with the group.
006: Has anyone heard from the client about the latest delivery?
Yes, yesterday they wrote to me saying they're very satisfied.
That's great news! That gives us some leeway for the next step.
Indeed, it's been a great effort on everyone's part.
Well, we must maintain this level of quality in the future.
I agree, it's a good incentive for the team.
007: I propose we set a date for the project review.
Sounds good, how about Thursday of next week?
Thursday morning works perfectly for me.
Me too, so let's consider it settled.
Perfect, I'll add it to the invitation and send it to you.
Okay, we'll keep an eye out for the invite.
008: I think we haven't talked about the risks of the new plan.
That's true, it's an aspect we shouldn't overlook.
Could you list the main risks you see?
The main one is the dependence on a single external supplier.
That's an important point, we should look for alternatives.
I'll take care of researching other options and presenting them.
009: To wrap things up, does anyone want to add anything else?
I just wanted to thank the team for their commitment to this project.
I join in the thanks, the work has been really good.
Honestly, you can really feel a good collaborative atmosphere.
Without a doubt, that makes reaching the goals much easier.
Well then, see you at the next meeting.
010: Before we close, I need someone to volunteer to write up the minutes.
I can take care of that, no problem.
Thank you very much, I really appreciate it.
You're welcome, it also gives me practice with writing.
Then, let's consider today's meeting concluded.
Perfect, thanks everyone for your participation.
